svg.text: OUT OF 1,000 PROFESSIONAL PITCHERS WHO HAVE THE SURGERY
Each mark is one pitcher. Count them if you like — that is the point of drawing it this way.
return, but at a LOWER level
THE GAP BETWEEN “CAME BACK” AND “CAME ALL THE WAY BACK” IS 56 PITCHERS.
791 of the 1,000 pitch again, which is the 80% everyone quotes. Only 735 get their level back.
Say it as 209 pitchers rather than 21% and it stops sounding like a rounding error.
Meta et al., Orthop J Sports Med 2025 · 2,281 MLB and minor-league pitchers, 2010–2023
